summary: A vulnerability was identified in Cockpit-HQ Cockpit up to 2.14.1. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file cron.php of the component Web Worker. Such manipulation of the argument token leads to missing authentication. The attack can be executed remotely. The attack requires a high level of complexity. The exploitation is known to be difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-134006 — A weakness has been identified in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2
summary: A weakness has been identified in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.7.2. title: CVE-2026-134533 — A vulnerability was identified in Skyvern-AI Skyvern 1

title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud

title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
summary: At least 178 top web destinations unwittingly served a variety of malware exploits against visitors over the past 24 hours thanks to a security vulnerability involving Optimizely, a company that helps websites customize user experiences and test out new features. Experts say the incident, which saw data-stealing malicious software silently injected into sites like the BBC, CNN, Equifax, Ledger and Zoom, was exacerbated by the reality that few popular websites enforce strict rules on the sources of third-party content.

title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
summary: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia.

title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.

title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today

title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site

mm/shmem: honour F_SEAL_EXEC when an ACL is set

The owner of a memfd sealed with F_SEAL_EXEC can still change its
execute bits by setting a POSIX access ACL. With CONFIG_TMPFS_POSIX_ACL,
this lets an unprivileged owner make a non-executable memfd executable,
bypassing vm.memfd_noexec=2.

simple_set_acl() updates i_mode directly, bypassing the seal check in
shmem_setattr(). Add shmem_set_acl() to check the resulting mode. Share
the F_SEAL_EXEC check with shmem_setattr() using memfd_check_seals_mode()
in include/linux/memfd.h.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

The iso8601_duration_re regular expression used to parse ISO 8601 durations (in pydantic/datetime_parse.py) contains an unescaped ".", which also matches digits. On a string of digits, the repeated groups overlap and the regex engine backtracks in quadratic time.

summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

io_uring/register: enforce per-task restrictions in io_uring_register_blind()

When io_uring_register(2) is invoked with fd == -1, it dispatches
directly to io_uring_register_blind() without checking
current->io_uring_restrict.

IORING_REGISTER_RESTRICTIONS can still invoke blind registration opcodes
such as IORING_REGISTER_SEND_MSG_RING even when those opcodes are not in
the task's allowed register_op bitmap.

title: CVE-2026-129840 — In the nrfconnect/ncs-zigbee repository, the GitHub Actions workflow
summary:
In the nrfconnect/ncs-zigbee repository, the GitHub Actions workflow
.github/workflows/build_documentation.yml used the pull_request_target trigger
while checking out and executing untrusted pull request code. This allowed a
pull request from a fork to run attacker-controlled code in the base repository
context with a write-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN (contents: write, pages: write,
pull-requests: write), enabling remote code execution in CI, token
exfiltration, and unauthorized modification of repository content and GitHub
Pages. The workflow was disabled and then rewritten to remove the issue.

title: CVE-2026-133531 — A flaw was found in cluster-network-operator
summary: A flaw was found in cluster-network-operator. The OVN IPsec certificate signer does not verify that the requested certificate Subject and DNS names belong to the requesting node. An attacker with an accepted OVN node credential and permission to submit certificate signing requests could obtain a signed certificate identifying another node. In certificate authenticated OVN IPsec deployments, this could enable peer impersonation when the attacker can also satisfy the configured peer address check, potentially compromising protected traffic.

title: CVE-2026-133622 — A flaw was found in certmonger
summary: A flaw was found in certmonger. This vulnerability allows a malicious certificate authority or an attacker positioned on an unencrypted network to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending oversized or deliberately slow responses. Certmonger fails to enforce size limits or transfer timeouts when downloading and buffering Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) replies over HTTP. Consequently, an attacker can exhaust host memory, drive CPU usage to capacity, or cause certificate requests to hang indefinitely.

title: CVE-2026-133648 — Flowintel disabled TLS certificate verification for all MISP API connections and used unverified SSL contexts for IMAP and SMTP STARTTLS mail connecti
summary:
Flowintel disabled TLS certificate verification for all MISP API connections and used unverified SSL contexts for IMAP and SMTP STARTTLS mail connections. This allowed an on-path (man-in-the-middle) attacker positioned between Flowintel and its MISP or mail servers to impersonate the remote server and intercept sensitive data.

Affected connections include:
- All MISP HTTPS API calls (event retrieval, attribute search, event creation, connectivity checks, and API validation)
- SMTP STARTTLS connections used for sending email notifications
- IMAP TLS connections used for fetching mail archives

title: CVE-2026-101340 — Net::DNS uses a 16-bit query ID to match responses to the corresponding requests
summary: Net::DNS uses a 16-bit query ID to match responses to the corresponding requests.  In versions up to and including 1.57, the ID is obtained from Perl's built-in rand() function.  An attacker that can observe the sequence of query IDs is able to expose the internal state of the PNRG and hence predict query IDs before they are transmitted.  The victim Net::DNS instance is then exposed to forged responses injected by the attacker.  Note that the deduplication cache in 1.57 has no impact on the feasibility of this attack.

title: CVE-2026-133699 — free5GC SMF through 1
summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability because sendPDUSessionEstablishmentAccept returns early without calling RemoveSMContextFromAllNF on failures. Authenticated UEs repeatedly establishing PDU sessions during NRF or AMF failures leak SM contexts, UE IP addresses and TEIDs, exhausting the DNN IP pool.

title: CVE-2026-133700 — free5GC SMF through 1
summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a resource leak vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextCreate that leaves SM contexts unreleased when UDM access token retrieval fails. Attackers can trigger repeated PDU session establishment attempts while the NRF is unreachable, causing empty 200 responses and persistent SMF memory growth.

title: CVE-2026-133701 — free5GC SMF through 1
summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextLocalRelease that orphans SM contexts and UE IP addresses when PFCP session deletion fails. Attackers can send repeated PDU session establishment requests reusing an existing SUPI and PDU Session ID during PFCP deletion failures to exhaust the DNN's UE IP pool.

title: CVE-2026-133702 — free5GC PCF through 1
summary: free5GC PCF through 1.4.6 contains a resource leak in postAppSessCtxProcedure that leaves PCC rules and QoS data in the SM policy decision after rejected Npcf_PolicyAuthorization create requests. Authenticated AFs knowing an active PDU session's UE address can send repeated failing requests with distinct AF application identifiers to grow PCF memory and pollute policy sent to the SMF.

title: CVE-2026-133703 — Open5GS AMF through 2
summary: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a resource leak vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to exhaust the session pool by triggering failed DNN or S-NSSAI validation. Attackers can repeat PDU Session Establishment Requests with different PDU Session Identity values, leaving stale amf_sess contexts that degrade service for other subscribers.

title: CVE-2026-133704 — Penpot 2
summary: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.18.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with edit rights to bypass the sanitize-svg-element blocklist using namespace-prefixed SVG elements. Attackers can upload SVGs containing elements like x:script or attributes like x:onload, which are served inline as image/svg+xml to run JavaScript in victims' Penpot sessions.

title: CVE-2026-133705 — Hanko before 3
summary: Hanko before 3.2.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in Saml.IsAllowedRedirect that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the redirect allowlist by appending attacker-controlled domain suffixes to allowed hostnames. Attackers can lure victims through a crafted /saml/auth login link to capture the one-time hanko_token and redeem it without PKCE to hijack the victim's session.

title: CVE-2026-133706 — request-filtering-agent before 3
summary: request-filtering-agent before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery filter bypass because address validation in src/request-filtering-agent.ts treats IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses in the ::/96 range as public unicast. Attackers controlling a fetched URL can use addresses like ::7f00:1 or ::a9fe:a9fe to reach loopback or link-local services, including cloud metadata endpoints.

title: CVE-2026-133707 — The targets R package before 1
summary: The targets R package before 1.12.1 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run arbitrary R code by planting format functions in the data store metadata file. Attackers can supply a crafted _targets data store whose custom format or CAS repository functions are passed to eval(parse()), executing code when victims call tar_read(), tar_load() or tar_workspace().

title: CVE-2026-133708 — diffpy
summary: diffpy.structure before 3.5.1 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by supplying crafted CIF symmetry operations passed to eval() in get_symop(). Attackers can embed expressions in the _space_group_symop_operation_xyz or _symmetry_equiv_pos_as_xyz loop to execute code with victim privileges when the CIF file is parsed locally.

title: CVE-2026-133709 — C-Blosc2 before 3
summary: C-Blosc2 before 3.4.1 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in frame_decompress_chunk() because sparse frame chunk cbytes are not checked against the actual chunk file size. Attackers can supply a sparse frame directory with a truncated or crafted chunk file to crash applications or leak adjacent heap memory into decompressed output.

title: CVE-2026-133710 — llama

Attackers can supply a GGUF model whose layer factors wrap modulo 2^32, causing load_arch_tensors() to write tensor pointers past model.layers, corrupting heap memory and potentially enabling code execution.

title: CVE-2026-127027 — Poste
summary:

Email sent to dmarc-reports@<domain> is saved without sender verification. Script that runs as root unpacks the attachments using unsafe shell commands, allowing command injection through crafted attachments (e.g. file names or archive contents). summary:
In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the PostgreSQL pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. An attacker who controls any monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres operating system user. This includes the PEM certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certificates for other agents and act as them.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents no longer hold these roles.

summary:

An attacker who controls one monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can create, change or delete jobs for every other agent, including the agent on the PEM server. Agents run SQL job steps with the database credentials of the server they monitor, and shell job steps where batch jobs are enabled, so compromising one monitored host can give superuser SQL access to every monitored database and to the PEM backend.

Any PEM user who can connect to the PEM backend database can create objects that these functions use in place of the intended ones, and so run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges. Temporary objects can be used for this on every supported PostgreSQL version, and objects in the public schema on PostgreSQL 14 backends and backends upgraded from PostgreSQL 14.

summary:
In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), multi-factor authentication (MFA) is not enforced on the PEM web application's own routes. An attacker who knows the password of a user who has enrolled a second factor can skip the second factor and call PEM's pages and APIs directly, with that user's permissions. A similar issue in pgAdmin 4 was assigned CVE-2024-4215.
From PEM 10.6.1, every authenticated PEM route requires a completed MFA check.

title: CVE-2026-132662 — In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the SQL Profiler save and load functions in the PEM web application do not keep the client-supplied file name in
summary:

A user with the SQL Profiler role (pem_comp_sqlprofiler) can read JSON files, and overwrite files that the PEM web server account can write, outside their own storage directory. Overwriting the PEM web application's configuration database stops the web console for all users.
From PEM 10.6.1, the SQL Profiler only reads and writes files inside the user's storage directory.

title: CVE-2026-132663 — In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), webhook URLs are not validated, and the PEM agent does not restrict the URL schemes it uses to deliver webhooks
summary:

A user with the alert configuration role (pem_config_alert) can set up a webhook with a file:// URL. When the webhook is sent, the agent on the PEM server, which runs as root by default, reads the local file and stores its contents in the webhook error record in the PEM database, where any PEM user can read it.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM accepts and sends only http and https webhook URLs.

title: CVE-2026-132664 — In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user can read the encrypted passwords that PEM agents use to connect to monitored servers, including the

Unless a custom encryption key is configured, these passwords are encrypted with a key that is the same in every PEM installation, so they can be decrypted.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM users can no longer read these passwords.

From PEM 10.6.1, PEM checks team access for every server, group and agent a template is deployed to.

title: CVE-2026-132668 — In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), any PEM user can run the pem
summary:

From PEM 10.6.1, no PEM login role can call this function directly. PEM still sends webhook notifications through its own internal paths.

title: CVE-2026-126540 — Convert::ASN1 versions before 0
summary:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via quadratic bigint loop in os2ip.

Every INTEGER or ENUMERATED longer than four content octets reaches os2ip, which iterates over each content octet with $result = ($result * 256) + $octet. Each multiplication operates on a bigint that grows by one octet per step, so decoding an n-octet value takes O(n^2) bigint work. Nothing limits content length before this loop runs.

An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust CPU with a single oversized INTEGER or ENUMERATED value.

title: CVE-2026-126682 — Convert::ASN1 versions before 0
summary:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding.

The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size.

An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

title: CVE-2026-126956 — Convert::ASN1 versions before 0
summary:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unlimited recursion depth in constructed-form string decoding.

Any constructed-form string element causes the decoder to recurse on the element's contents. The BER encoding controls nesting depth at four bytes per level, with no bound checked. Perl recursion is heap-allocated, so the process grows without a stack crash.

An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a small deeply nested constructed string.

title: CVE-2026-131868 — Convert::ASN1 versions before 0
summary:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get.

The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB.

A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.
title_vi: CVE-2026-131868 — Convert::ASN1 các phiên bản trước 0

title: CVE-2026-131877 — Convert::ASN1 versions before 0
summary:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via unbounded arc length in OBJECT IDENTIFIER decoding and encoding.

The content of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER or RELATIVE-OID element is passed to unpack "w*" on decode, and the arcs of an OID string to pack "w*" on encode. Perl converts each arc to or from its decimal string in time quadratic in the arc's length, and nothing limits that length.

An attacker who controls the decoded data, or an OID string passed to encode, can exhaust CPU with a single oversized arc.

summary:

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. summary:
Mixed-case HTTPS and FTPS URLs can expose data in plaintext.

The HTTP and FTP stream wrappers recognise URL schemes case-insensitively, but enable TLS only when the scheme contains a lowercase "s" at a fixed position. A URL such as HTTPS:// or FTPS:// passed to file_get_contents(), fopen() or other stream functions, or received as an HTTP redirect target, is therefore handled over unencrypted HTTP or FTP. An attacker able to observe the network traffic can read data the application expected TLS to protect, including credentials, request bodies and transferred files.

title: CVE-2026-128090 — PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade
summary:
PHAR OpenSSL signature bypass via algorithm downgrade.

The Phar extension selects the signature verification method from the signature type stored in the archive, and only the OpenSSL types consult the separate .pubkey file holding the trusted public key. An attacker who can modify an OpenSSL-signed Phar archive, but not its public key file, can switch the signature type to a keyless hash such as SHA-256 with a recomputed digest, so the altered archive passes verification even with phar.require_hash enabled. An application that loads the archive may then execute attacker-controlled PHP code.

summary:

The XML serializer of Dom\XMLDocument and Dom\HTMLDocument can share ownership of a generated namespace prefix between the namespace-prefix maps of an element and a descendant, so the prefix is used after being freed and then freed a second time. title: CVE-2026-129506 — SOAP use-after-free when processing DTD entity references
summary:

The SOAP extension frees the document type definition (DTD) of a parsed XML document while attribute values can still refer to entities it owns, and can then read freed memory. summary:

summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: core: Fix out-of-bounds left shift by 32 in s32ton()

Syzbot reported an out-of-bounds shift (32-bit integer shifted left by
32) in the s32ton() routine in the HID core.  This routine converts a
signed 32-bit integer to a signed n-bit integer, and it caps the value
of n at 32.  But when n == 32 there's no need to do anything; it can
simply return the input value.  This will avoid calculating (1 << n)

summary:

summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

When the ACPI memory properties are missing or the C2C link is down, the

title: CVE-2026-133059 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-133060 — A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-133061 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing capability check in the grade items web service, an authenticated user with a student role can view the names of all grade items in a course, including those intended to be hidden. This flaw leads to unauthorized information disclosure of hidden course assessment details.

title: CVE-2026-133062 — A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin. Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

title: CVE-2026-133063 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient validation when saving activity settings, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify activities in courses they are not authorized to access. This flaw allows unauthorized changes to course materials, compromising the integrity of course content.

title: CVE-2026-133064 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient sanitization of objective identifiers in the SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) objectives report allows an authenticated user with content upload permissions to inject malicious scripts. When another user views the report, the injected script executes in their browser session, potentially allowing the attacker to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.

title: CVE-2026-133065 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient permission checks and input validation in the quiz question bank callback, an authenticated user can access and view questions from question banks they do not have permission to access. Furthermore, this issue allows users to trigger arbitrary class instantiation (creating unintended application objects), potentially leading to further unauthorized actions.

title: CVE-2026-133066 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing ownership verification in Feedback activity templates allows an authenticated teacher to view, use, or delete templates associated with courses other than their own. This can result in unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of course materials.

title: CVE-2026-133067 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

title: CVE-2026-133068 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

title: CVE-2026-133069 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing authorization checks in the forum discussion web services allow authenticated users to view discussion information in courses they do not have permission to access. In addition, users with teacher privileges may lock forum discussions in courses where they lack proper authorization. This issue can lead to unauthorized information disclosure and unauthorized discussion state modification.

title: CVE-2026-133070 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when viewing and restoring wiki page versions, an authenticated user can access content from courses they are not permitted to view. This issue allows an attacker to inspect restricted course material and copy it into their own wiki pages, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-133071 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when editing Lesson activity pages, authenticated users with teacher privileges can view and move lesson pages from courses they are not permitted to access into their own lessons. This issue can lead to unauthorized access and modification of restricted course content.

title: CVE-2026-133072 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz editing functionality allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to view slot details and modify sections of quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this flaw to alter quiz configurations or disclose quiz structure information without proper authorization.

title: CVE-2026-133073 — A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-133074 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

title: CVE-2026-133075 — A flaw was found in Moodle
summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient authorization checks in the quiz random question filter web service, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify random question settings in quizzes they do not have permission to manage. This flaw allows unauthorized users to alter assessment configurations across courses they do not oversee.

title: CVE-2026-133233 — Quasar before 2
summary: Quasar before 2.35.3 contains a DOM clobbering vulnerability that allows attackers to break native wrapper detection by injecting HTML elements named Capacitor, cordova, or StatusBar. Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

title: CVE-2026-133234 — Stoatchat before 0
summary: Stoatchat before 0.16.5 contains an unbounded JXL image decoding vulnerability in revolt_files decode_image that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory via the january /proxy endpoint. Attackers can request a small hosted JXL file declaring 12000x12000 pixels through /proxy to trigger huge allocations, OOM-killing january and denying proxy and embed service.

title: CVE-2026-133235 — Tandoor Recipes before 2
summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file/<id>/ to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

title: CVE-2026-133236 — Modoboa before 2
summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

title: CVE-2026-133237 — Manyfold 0
summary: Manyfold 0.124.0 before 0.154.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to make the instance fetch internal URLs by supplying malicious ActivityPub actor icon.url and image.url fields. Attackers can deliver Create or Update activities to the inbox, causing the Shrine remote_url plugin to request internal or cloud metadata hosts and store responses as creator avatar or banner attachments.

title: CVE-2026-133238 — SABnzbd through 5
summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

title: CVE-2026-133239 — OpnForm before 2
summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to move other forms' shared assets by supplying their URLs in file upload fields. Attackers can submit a public form with another form's cover or logo URL, causing Storage::move() to relocate it into submissions and break that asset.

title: CVE-2026-133240 — OpnForm before 2
summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

title: CVE-2026-133241 — diaspora* before 0
summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject iframe attributes via the maxheight parameter of the GET /oembed endpoint. Attackers can supply a single quote in maxheight to inject an onload handler into the returned html, executing script in third-party oEmbed consumers that embed it unsanitized.

title: CVE-2026-133242 — diaspora* before 0
summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

title: CVE-2026-133243 — node-soap before 1
summary: node-soap before 1.14.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in WSDL.xmlToObject that allows unauthenticated attackers to pollute Object.prototype via an XML element with id="__proto__". Attackers can send a single crafted SOAP request to a soap.listen() server, or return a malicious response to a client, causing all subsequent SOAP parsing to fail until process restart.

title: CVE-2026-133244 — parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7
summary: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

title: CVE-2026-133245 — parse5 7
summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

title: CVE-2026-133246 — modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3
summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows administrators to include arbitrary server files by storing ../ sequences in the content manager file name. Unauthenticated requests to shop_content.php then pass the stored path to include(), executing embedded PHP in uploaded content files or images as the web server user.

title: CVE-2026-133247 — modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3
summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in admin/support.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the module parameter. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into opening a crafted link to run script in the admin panel, reading CSRF tokens and changing shop settings.

title: CVE-2026-133248 — modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3
summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows administrators with product editing permission to inject script via the products_name field. The unescaped name is rendered in the h1 heading of product detail and reviews pages, executing script in the browsers of shoppers and logged-in customers.

title: CVE-2026-133274 — THC-Hydra through 9
summary: THC-Hydra through 9.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in analyze_server_response() of hydra-http-form.c that allows malicious HTTP servers to corrupt memory via crafted Set-Cookie headers. Attackers can send a Set-Cookie header with an extra leading space followed by a repeated cookie name, causing a negative strncpy length that overflows tmpcookie and crashes Hydra.

title: CVE-2026-133275 — A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10
summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an arbitrary file upload attack due to insufficient file type validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary files to the target system. This is MTLVULN-1861.

title: CVE-2026-62255 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, cram_index_load does not verify that the number of reference sequences in a CRAM .crai index does not exceed the CRAM header reference count. A malformed index can drive unbounded index-array allocation, and when the number of references in the index is within two of INT_MAX, the growth calculation can wrap, read beyond a heap buffer, and use the resulting value as a pointer for an unchecked memory write. Any region query can trigger the flaw, causing denial of service or memory

title: CVE-2026-62256 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, fai_retrieve does not verify that the line width recorded in a FASTA .fai index is greater than or equal to the number of bases per line. When the line width is exactly one less than the base count, retrieval allocates an undersized heap buffer and writes one byte beyond its end; larger discrepancies instead cause an allocation failure that is handled. This issue can corrupt heap memory and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

title: CVE-2026-62257 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 XPACK and XRLE decoders cache expanded block pointers at indexes beyond the 512-element slice->block_by_id array. An array index partially controlled by data in the input file first causes an out-of-bounds read to determine whether a block is cached; a null value then causes allocation of a block and an out-of-bounds pointer write to the same element. The invalid read may crash the process, while the write may corrupt heap state and could permit arbitrary

title: CVE-2026-62258 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM decoder validates the 254-character query-name limit only after decoding the name into a 1024-byte stack array. An attacker-controlled CRAM record can provide an overlong query name and overflow the local stack buffer before the later validation runs; all CRAM format versions are affected. Opening such a file can crash the process, corrupt stack data, and may permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

title: CVE-2026-62259 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 functions cram_xpack_decode_char and cram_xrle_decode_char do not validate that attacker-controlled decode sizes remain within their expanded input arrays. Crafted CRAM data can therefore make either decoder read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially disclosing process-state information or crashing the process through invalid memory access. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

title: CVE-2026-62260 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM BETA decoder functions cram_beta_decode_long, cram_beta_decode_int, and cram_beta_decode_char, and the experimental CRAM v4 XPACK functions cram_xpack_decode_long and cram_xpack_decode_int, have bounds-checking flaws caused by integer overflow after a multiplication. The resulting incorrect bounds check can allow decoding to read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially leaking process-state information or crashing the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2

title: CVE-2026-63390 — HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats
summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the BCF reader can experience an integer overflow in a record-length check that verifies whether a record contains enough bytes for the expected number and size of stored items. A crafted BCF record can bypass this check, causing reads beyond the stored data and, in some cases, writes beyond the heap buffer when the reader sets the least significant bit of accessed bytes. title: CVE-2026-105802 — Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files
summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.6.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS reads Git configuration options defined for a submodule without checking certain values for embedded line-ending control characters. A malicious repository can insert control characters such as line feed (LF) into those values to mimic options that cause Git LFS to execute an attacker-controlled command or binary while fetching or adding objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

title: CVE-2026-105803 — Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files
summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 1.3.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not correctly filter the limited set of options permitted in a repository's .lfsconfig file when option keys contain certain additional components. Crafted keys can mimic options that configure Git LFS to use a custom command to transfer objects, causing Git LFS to execute an attacker-selected command or binary while fetching objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

title: CVE-2026-129232 — NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Lang
summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, XMLCorpusView.read_block rebuilds the full root-to-node context path with "/".join(context) for every start tag while searching for a matching element. Deeply nested attacker-influenced corpus XML therefore causes quadratic pure-Python work and can pin a processing worker, resulting in denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

title: CVE-2026-129234 — NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Lang
summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, Prover9Parent.config_prover9 and Mace accept a relative binary_location and pass it to find_binary as path_to_bin, disabling the bare-name absolute-path guard. A local attacker who can plant prover9 or mace4 in the resolved working directory can cause subprocess.Popen to execute that binary with the invoking user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file write leading to remote code execution in CSS editor in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The CSS editor did not restrict file names, extensions and paths of created and saved files, allowing privileged backend users to write arbitrary PHP files.

title: CVE-2026-129397 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file deletion via path traversal in CSS editor in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file deletion via path traversal in CSS editor in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The delete and rename tasks of the CSS editor lacked authorization checks, CSRF protection and path validation, allowing backend users to delete files outside the CSS directory.

title: CVE-2026-129398 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Authorization bypass in saveAjaxTextarea task in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Authorization bypass in saveAjaxTextarea task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The saveAjaxTextarea task did not check edit permissions and accepted arbitrary table and column names, allowing backend users to modify the configuration of any form, including notification recipients.

title: CVE-2026-129400 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated verification mail amplification in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated verification mail amplification in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The verification mail task accepted arbitrary form IDs and recipients without rate limiting, allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger mass verification mails and database entries.

summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Open redirect on invalid form submission in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The return parameter of an invalid form submission was not validated, allowing redirects to external sites.

summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Input placeholders in SQL field statements were inserted without quoting in the public reload task, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection in read queries.

title: CVE-2026-129404 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in form import and field creation in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in form import and field creation in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The core.create.sql.statement permission was not enforced when importing forms or creating new fields, allowing backend users without this permission to store arbitrary SQL statements.

title: CVE-2026-129409 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Open redirects in data view controller and after form submission in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Open redirects in data view controller and after form submission in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Return and redirect URLs taken from user input in the data/PDF controller and after a successful form submission were not validated, allowing redirects to external sites.

title: CVE-2026-129410 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Code injection via calculation formulas in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Code injection via calculation formulas in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Calculation field formulas were executed using PHP eval() without validating their content, allowing backend users with field edit permissions to execute arbitrary PHP code.

title: CVE-2026-129411 — Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension 1
summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Sorting, location radius and published filters of the frontend data view were not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection, partly without authentication.

summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - IDOR in backend data export in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The backend export did not correctly verify permissions for the exported form, allowing backend users to export data of forms they are not authorized to access.

summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Access restriction bypass for form submissions in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Form submissions did not check the access level of the form, allowing guests to submit forms restricted to specific user groups.

title: CVE-2026-131610 — In ConnectWise Automate versions prior to 2026
summary:
In ConnectWise Automate versions prior to
2026.11, a condition in Web Control Center (WCC2) authorization handling could
allow an authenticated contact user to access information associated with other
clients on the same Automate server through API requests. This may result in
disclosure of information outside the user’s assigned access scope. The issue
is limited to information disclosure and does not extend existing modification
or command execution permissions. This issue is resolved in ConnectWise
Automate 2026.11.

title: CVE-2026-133007 — A flaw was found in GIMP
summary: A flaw was found in GIMP. Opening a crafted XCF with a truncated uncompressed tile can expose uninitialized main-process stack memory through the imported layer's pixel data, which may include process addresses that weaken ASLR.

title: CVE-2026-133189 — A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support
summary: A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface. Commands execute with the privileges of Cinder's configured backend account. This can disclose storage configuration information and, where that account has administrative permissions, could allow changes that affect the integrity or availability of other tenants'

title: CVE-2026-133200 — A flaw was found in quarkus-vertx-utils
summary: A flaw was found in quarkus-vertx-utils. When a client disconnects while receiving a streaming response, the server fails to detect the closed connection and continues processing the data indefinitely. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this issue by repeatedly initiating streaming requests and disconnecting, exhausting worker threads and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

title: CVE-2026-133276 — When extra data is allowed (extra=Extra
summary: When extra data is allowed (extra=Extra.allow), providing a __pydantic_initialised__ key when validating a Pydantic V1 dataclass makes it considered as already validated, resulting in field values not being validated. The __init__() method of Pydantic V1 dataclasses stores all the provided keyword arguments in the instance __dict__ before validation, so a __pydantic_initialised__ keyword argument overrides the internal flag used to skip validation of already validated instances. As a result, data returned by validation doesn't match the declared type. Affected are applications validating untru

title: CVE-2026-133303 — A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10
summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862.

title: CVE-2026-133305 — sqlmap before 1
summary: sqlmap before 1.10.11.89 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows attackers to capture user-supplied Cookie and Authorization headers by redirecting requests to another host. Attackers controlling the scanned target or abusing an open redirect can make RedirectHandler.http_error_302 forward session cookies or bearer tokens to an attacker-controlled host.

title: CVE-2026-133306 — VideoLAN libaacs 0
summary: VideoLAN libaacs 0.7.0 through 0.12.0 on non-macOS, non-Windows builds contains stack-based buffer overflows in aacs_resolve_path() in src/file/path.c from length checks against the wrong buffer. Local attackers can place a symlink with a long target on a disc path a user opens to overflow resolved_path[] and link[], crashing the process or potentially executing code if mitigations are bypassed.

title: CVE-2026-133307 — ClassiCube before 1
summary: ClassiCube before 1.4.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Png_Decode in src/Bitmap.c that allows malicious servers to corrupt client memory by sending a PNG with a duplicate IHDR chunk. Attackers can supply crafted PNGs via texture pack URLs or player skins so the unreset bufferIdx underflows remaining space, letting IDAT data overflow the buffer to crash clients or execute code.

title: CVE-2026-133308 — ClassiCube before 1
summary: ClassiCube before 1.4.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Png_Reconstruct in src/Bitmap.c that occurs when AVERAGE and PAETH filters process zero-width PNG images. A malicious multiplayer server can supply a crafted texture pack URL or player skin to write past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing connecting clients.

title: CVE-2026-133309 — @scalar/typebox before 0
summary: @scalar/typebox before 0.1.4 contains a code injection vulnerability in TypeCompiler that allows attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying crafted schema strings. Attackers can inject single-quote breakouts into string format, Kind names, property keys or Literal values to run arbitrary JavaScript in the host Node.js process during Compile() and Check().

title: CVE-2026-133310 — Wing FTP Server before 8
summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a file mask bypass vulnerability allowing attackers to upload restricted files via an embedded NUL byte in Upload Link filenames. Attackers can plant a Lua session file with a chosen UID and send a matching UID cookie to execute operating system commands as the service account.

title: CVE-2026-133311 — A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10
summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker, with knowledge of a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability is limited to the affected functionality and does not provide unrestricted access to arbitrary files elsewhere on the system. This is MTLVULN-1863.

title: CVE-2026-133323 — A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10
summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

title: CVE-2026-133324 — A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10
summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an authentication bypass attack due to improper handling of authentication. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the context of the application. This is MTLVULN-1877.

title: CVE-2026-22309 — The visitor tracking of JTL-Shop automatically registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering the value, and the stored value is rendered wit
summary:
The visitor tracking of JTL-Shop automatically
registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering the value, and the stored
value is rendered without output encoding on several pages of the
administration backend (search engine statistics, crawler dashboard widget, crawler
edit form, sitemap export download list and campaign details). An
unauthenticated remote attacker can store script code with a single request. The code is
executed in the browser session of an administrator who opens one of these
pages, allowing actions to be performed with the administrator's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-22310 — When the setting for saving requests to non-existent pages (404) is enabled, JTL-Shop stores the raw requested URL in its redirect table, and the admi
summary:
When the setting for saving requests to non-existent
pages (404) is enabled, JTL-Shop stores the raw requested URL in its
redirect table, and the administration backend renders it without output
encoding in the form used to edit a redirect. An unauthenticated remote
attacker can store script code with a single request, which is executed in the
browser session of an administrator who opens the affected redirect,
allowing actions to be performed with the administrator's privileges. The
setting is disabled by default in new installations but may still be
enabled in older ones.

title: CVE-2026-47278 — Frappe is a full-stack web application framework
summary: Frappe is a full-stack web application framework. Prior to 15.108.0 and 16.18.3, the add_comment handler in frappe/templates/includes/comments/comments.py trusts the client-provided comment_by and comment_email fields. A caller can submit chosen identity metadata that is stored with a comment, causing the comment to appear to originate from another name or email address. This issue is fixed in versions 15.108.0 and 16.18.3.

summary: django-docutils provides reStructuredText support for Django. title: CVE-2026-69261 — Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files
summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS may forward a Cookie header after an HTTP redirect to a host other than the one for which the header was intended. That unintended host can therefore receive cookies containing credentials or other confidential values. Authorization headers are never forwarded to inappropriate hosts and are not the affected secret in this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

summary: Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. An unauthenticated network caller can use /api/connect to replace runtime_url and document_url values and their tokens, reset ServerContext, and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure, causing the server to send Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to that backend. The caller can also use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel.

title: CVE-2026-131241 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission for containers on only a subset of container labels could modify container pins outside the container labels that the role permits.
The vulnerability is possible because the Container Pin Representational State Transfer (REST) API does not enforce the container label authorization boundary when handling requests.

summary:

This could expose action parameters, connector result summaries, and other investigation and response activity.
The vulnerability is possible because the Splunk SOAR Representational State Transfer (REST) API checks the permission to view containers but does not restrict automation history to containers within the label or tenant scope assigned to the user.

title: CVE-2026-131243 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view an affected container could query the Representational State Transfer (REST) API for approvals to retrieve a live external prompt link belonging to another user. Using this link, the user could read the approval prompt without authentication and submit a response, potentially disrupting or altering the automated workflow governed by that approval.
The vulnerability is possible because the REST API for approvals exposes the live external prompt link without verifying that the requester owns the approval.

title: CVE-2026-131244 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could modify a child playbook callback handle associated with another playbook run, which could alter the callback behavior of that run.
The vulnerability exists because the Playbook API does not verify that callback-handle updates belong to the related parent and child playbook runs.

title: CVE-2026-131245 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission for the container label of a pending external prompt could obtain the external prompt link through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API and use the link to view and resolve the associated approval.
The vulnerability is possible because the approval detail REST API includes the external prompt link in responses outside the assigned approval scope.

summary:

title: CVE-2026-131247 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:

The vulnerability is possible because the playbook API uses mutable runtime context to identify a playbook run instead of preserving the server-provided context.

title: CVE-2026-131248 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8

title: CVE-2026-131249 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view, edit, and run playbooks and access to at least one container label could retrieve a callback handle from a playbook run outside the container-label scope granted to that account.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify that the requested callback handle belongs to the parent playbook run that launched the child playbook.

summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to edit containers for an allowed label could forge the author attribution of container pins and access limited user details outside the expected authorization boundary.
The Container Pin Representational State Transfer (REST) API does not prevent caller-provided author fields from reaching generic model binding, which lets the request reassign a pin author or query user-related data outside the expected authorization scope.

title: CVE-2026-131251 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to view and modify containers with an allowed label could add artifacts to containers that the user cannot view or modify.
The vulnerability is possible because the Representational State Transfer (REST) API artifact-creation workflow does not preserve the authorization boundary for the selected container.

title: CVE-2026-131252 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Assets edit or delete permission and access to one or more tenants could change or delete assets assigned to other tenants through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API. title: CVE-2026-131253 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the Apps edit, Containers edit, and Playbooks execute permissions could use the App Wizard to execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR. This could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the Splunk SOAR instance.
The vulnerability exists because the App Wizard does not validate user-supplied identifiers before incorporating them into generated connector code.

title: CVE-2026-131254 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to create containers on one label could use the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to create a container with a parent relationship to a container that the user cannot access. This could let the user alter incident lineage across authorization boundaries and identify existing restricted containers.
The vulnerability is possible because the REST API accepts a customer-supplied parent relationship when creating a container without authorizing access to the referenced container.

title: CVE-2026-131255 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an unauthenticated user could gain administrator privileges through a user account that receives an unintended role. A user that holds a role with permission to create or modify users and assign roles must assign the target account a role with a numeric name through the user-management Representational State Transfer (REST) API.
The vulnerability is possible because the API resolves a numeric role name as a role identifier instead of preserving the requested role name.

title: CVE-2026-131256 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could execute arbitrary code on the host that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because the Representational State Transfer (REST) API accepts package references from untrusted sources and passes them to the dependency installer.

title: CVE-2026-131257 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to view and edit containers and at least one container label could set misleading user and app provenance on containers that the user creates and learn whether user IDs and installed app identifiers exist.
The vulnerability is possible because the Representational State Transfer (REST) API accepts client-supplied values for server-managed container fields.

title: CVE-2026-131258 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission for a container or workbook task could store attacker-controlled Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) in a note. When another user with view permission for the affected container and its notes opens the affected note in Mission Control, the note could run unauthorized JavaScript code in the browser of that user, expose data available through the authenticated session, and perform actions available through the authenticated session.

title: CVE-2026-131259 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to create and view containers for a label could use the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to create a container that references a workbook phase in a case the user cannot view, disclosing the phase name and creating an inconsistent phase association.
The vulnerability exists because the Container REST API does not enforce the same case-scoped authorization when it accepts a workbook-phase reference during container creation.

title: CVE-2026-131260 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with the containers:edit permission could import a container that includes a malicious Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) note. When another user views the imported note, Splunk SOAR could run unauthorized JavaScript in the browser of that user, exposing data and allowing actions available to that user.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not sanitize HTML note content during container import before it renders the content in Mission Control.

title: CVE-2026-131261 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR by installing a malicious app.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not restrict app dependencies to validated binary packages before installing them.

title: CVE-2026-131262 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can view and edit containers in at least one container label could create artifacts with parent relationships to containers and artifacts outside those labels. This could expose fields from restricted artifacts and modify incident lineage.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify access to the selected parent container and parent artifact when it creates an artifact.

title: CVE-2026-131263 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with only the apps:edit permission could install a connector app that causes Splunk SOAR to write attacker-controlled files outside the app directory. This could let the user modify files used by Splunk SOAR and execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR constructs the dependency installation command from app-supplied metadata without preventing that metadata from changing its arguments.

title: CVE-2026-131264 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to send the stored root credential for an external credential store to a host that the user controls. Depending on the configuration, the exposed credential could include an access token, application secret, account password, or client certificate.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR reuses the stored credential when the user changes the external credential store endpoint without supplying replacement credentials.

title: CVE-2026-131265 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings view permission but not the Assets view permission could view asset names, asset identifiers, app names, tenant names, and ingestion schedule settings for polling assets in the ingestion schedule view.
The vulnerability is possible because the ingestion schedule view does not verify the Assets view permission before it returns data derived from assets.

title: CVE-2026-131266 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to send a stored Elasticsearch password to a host that the user controls.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR reuses a stored Elasticsearch password for a changed Search Settings endpoint without requiring a replacement password.

title: CVE-2026-131267 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings view and edit permissions could test a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol authentication provider and cause Splunk SOAR to send a stored directory service account bind password to a host that the user controls.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR reuses a stored directory service provider credential when an authentication test uses a different directory service connection destination.

title: CVE-2026-131268 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use a customer automation dependency to execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not properly separate customer automation dependencies from trusted product code.

title: CVE-2026-131269 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to execute arbitrary code on the host when the user validates an installed app.
The vulnerability is possible because the app validation workflow does not isolate untrusted code from the trusted environment.

title: CVE-2026-131270 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with repository edit access could cause Splunk SOAR to write files outside the configured repository, which lets the user modify files that the user account running Splunk SOAR can write to.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not require source control repository paths to remain inside the configured repository.

title: CVE-2026-131271 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers for one label could use a slash command through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to access sensitive product data and credentials outside the authorized container scope.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not enforce authorization for related objects that slash commands access from an authorized artifact.

title: CVE-2026-131272 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use the Automation Dependency Wheel Representational State Transfer (REST) API to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory, which could lead to arbitrary code execution.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not restrict uploaded automation dependency wheel filenames to the intended storage directory.

title: CVE-2026-131273 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who holds a role with permission to view system settings but not assets could view asset, app, and container-label metadata in Ingestion filters.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR returns Ingestion filter metadata without applying asset authorization and tenant restrictions.

title: CVE-2026-131274 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with the system_settings permission could change event custom field definitions without the changes appearing in the audit trail, reducing forensic visibility and change accountability.
The issue occurs because Splunk SOAR does not audit custom field definition changes.

title: CVE-2026-131275 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with container edit permission could supply timestamps when creating containers and artifacts through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API. This could alter the timeline shown to analysts and cause configured data retention strategies to delete affected records earlier than intended.
The vulnerability is possible because the REST API accepts client-supplied values for timestamps that Splunk SOAR uses to order records and apply data retention.

title: CVE-2026-131276 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the System Settings view permission but not the Assets view permission could view asset and tenant metadata in the ingestion history view.
The ingestion history view does not restrict summary results to assets and tenants that the user can view.

title: CVE-2026-131277 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with permission to edit playbooks and repositories could store a modified utility block in a playbook. If a user that holds a role with permission to edit playbook code later opens and saves the playbook in the Visual Playbook Editor, a subsequent playbook run could send a Representational State Transfer (REST) API delete request to a resource outside the intended data list. The user account that runs the playbook must have permission to delete the target resource.

title: CVE-2026-131278 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with local access to the affected host could obtain a live Splunk SOAR session token or decrypted asset configuration when another user starts an App Editor debug action.
The vulnerability is possible because App Editor debug actions expose sensitive runtime information to other local users on the affected host.

title: CVE-2026-131279 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit artifacts could cause indicator correlation data to retain stale field associations, which can produce incorrect correlation results and event counts.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not remove stale indicator associations when an artifact changes.

title: CVE-2026-131280 — In Splunk SOAR versions below 8
summary:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user whose role grants system_settings:view but not assets:view could access asset and application inventory, tenant identifiers, connector run messages, and stored configuration snapshots through the ingestion status Representational State Transfer (REST) API.
The vulnerability is possible because the ingestion status REST API checks the system_settings:view permission but does not enforce assets:view or tenant restrictions before it returns asset-derived ingestion records.
